title: Flight Club
summary: 驾驶战机穿越虫洞，从地表飞向宇宙
description:
驾驶战机穿越虫洞，到达世界的另一端，从地表飞向宇宙，再驶向星球降落。自由探索、竞速、金币冲刺与空战，支持 Cardputer Zero 体感操控。
创意来源：https://remix.ui8.ai/fly

Pilot a fighter through wormholes to the other side of the world. Fly from the surface into space, then head toward a planet and land. Explore freely, race, collect coins, and fight aerial battles with Cardputer Zero motion controls.
Creative inspiration: https://remix.ui8.ai/fly
